title: Public money, political advantage?
snippet: Centre for Public Integrity research on pork barrelling, marginal seats and Major and Local Community Infrastructure Program invitations. CPI Table 3 reports $223,128,975 for marginal seats where Labor was competitive, versus $156,587,679 under a seat-count proportional baseline. Attributed CPI analysis, not independently replicated by Opax; no finding about individual project merit. Labor safe: $125,125,027.00 invitation value; $137,946,289.00 proportional baseline. Labor fairly safe: $144,931,587.00 invitation value; $82,022,118.00 proportional baseline. Marginal, Labor competitive: $223,128,975.00 invitation value; $156,587,679.00 proportional baseline. Marginal, Labor non-competitive: $5,230,000.00 invitation value; $37,282,781.00 proportional baseline. Other parties fairly safe: $28,276,123.00 invitation value; $55,924,171.00 proportional baseline. Other parties safe: $32,550,000.00 invitation value; $89,478,674.00 proportional baseline.

title: MLCI program: invitations and awards
snippet: 226 active invitations total $559,241,712 at 14 November 2025; separately, 89 published awards total $242,781,386.00 in Opax at 2026-09-09. Invitations are not awards or payments; do not add totals. New South Wales: $135,299,400.00 in active invitations. Victoria: $205,854,335.00 in active invitations. Queensland: $51,402,327.00 in active invitations. Western Australia: $49,160,207.00 in active invitations. South Australia: $40,392,000.00 in active invitations.
